description: This file defines the `CalendarProviderRegistry` class responsible for managing calendar provider types, including discovering, loading, and registering providers, as well as retrieving provider instances for specific accounts within the SuiteCRM application.

classes.name: CalendarProviderRegistry
classes.description: A registry class managing calendar provider types, discovering provider configurations from filesystem, caching provider data, and providing methods to retrieve provider instances and related information.

methods.name: loadProviders
methods.description: Loads calendar provider definitions, utilizing cached data if available, or discovering new providers.

methods.name: discoverProviders
methods.description: Discovers and registers calendar providers by scanning configuration files in predefined directories.

methods.name: writeCalendarSourceTypesToExtension
methods.description: Writes calendar source types to language extension files for customization and localization.

methods.name: getCalendarSourceTypes
methods.description: Returns a list of enabled calendar source types with user-friendly names.

methods.name: findEnabled
methods.description: Filters and returns only enabled provider types.

methods.name: getProviderForAccount
methods.description: Creates and returns a calendar provider instance suitable for the given calendar account.

methods.name: findBySource
methods.description: Finds a provider type by its source identifier if it exists and is enabled.

methods.name: exists
methods.description: Checks if a provider type exists for the specified source.

methods.name: getInternalProviderForAccount
methods.description: Returns an internal calendar provider instance configured with the given account.

methods.name: getAuthMethodForSource
methods.description: Retrieves the authentication method used for a specific provider source.
